Hi Alice,

Great to meet on Friday — thanks for the clear objectives. As discussed, we want to align on a short preflight and a 2-week stabilization plan for the private deployment (VPC peering + private endpoints + optional on-prem package). Goal is to have networking validated, an initial cutover window scheduled, and a rollback plan documented before the install.

Quick ask: can you confirm 2 things so we can finalize the runbook?
- Which VPC CIDR ranges will be used for your prod VPC and the tunnel (public internet egress will be restricted)?
- Do you have a preferred NAT/egress IP range for outbound callbacks (so we can whitelist in the console)?

I've attached our preflight checklist and a blank diagram template for your team to annotate. High-level owner list is below — I'm copying the engineers who will lead the cutover.

Proposed kickoff window: Wed 2028-06-14 10:00-11:30 PT (1.5h) — please flag conflicts.

Action owners:
- Laura (CS): overall schedule + success criteria
- Marissa (Solutions Eng): peering, routing validation, endpoint placement
- Ben (Network Ops): VPN configuration, firewall rules, NAT
- Irene (Security): compliance signoff (logging, encryption, audit)

Thanks — attaching: network-preflight-checklist.pdf, nurohealth-vpc-diagram.vsdx

Best,
Laura Bennett

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear plan and the checklist. Quick answers below:

- Prod VPC CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16
- Tunnel peer CIDR (we prefer): 10.200.0.0/24 for the peering side
- NAT egress IPs: 198.51.100.23-25 (we can reserve these)

We can confirm the annotated diagram by EOD Tuesday. Kickoff window Wed 10:00 PT works for our leads (I routed to infra).

Couple of notes from our infra team (cc'd):
- We require TLS 1.2+ for management plane traffic and mutual TLS for agent registration.
- Audit logs must be forwarded to our SIEM (Splunk) — can you confirm the formatting and retention options?

We'll upload the diagram to the drive link you shared.

Thanks,

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Connectivity preflight & stabilization plan for private deployment

Thanks Alice — good data. I pulled the initial sequencing into the runbook and uploaded a short validation checklist in the Drive folder. Highlights and engineering asks below:

1) Peering and routing
- We'll create the peering config for Redwood-managed side with route table entries for 10.40.0.0/16 -> peering connection. Ben to share the Terraform snippet.
- Please ensure your route propagation is enabled for the table covering 10.40.0.0/16.

2) Private endpoints and DNS
- For private endpoints (model-control, metrics, and artifact fetch), we prefer colocating endpoints in a dedicated subnet (recommended /26) to simplify ACLs.
- Alice: can infra confirm whether DNS resolution for our private suffix will be resolvable via your VPC resolver? If not, we'll bring a conditional-forwarder plan.

3) Agent/on-prem package
- If you take the on-prem package, agent registration will require a mutual-TLS cert and a short-lived JWT from your identity provider. Irene: can you prepare the compliance checklist for cert rotation and KMS usage?

4) Audit logs and SIEM
- Our platform can forward JSON-line logs over TLS to a customer-hosted collector. Format: RFC 3339 timestamps, event_type, request_id, model_id. Irene: will validate retention policy mapping to your Splunk index.

Attachments: I pushed a sample Terraform snippet and an updated preflight (network-preflight-checklist.pdf).

Next steps
- Laura: confirm kickoff link and invite
- Ben: share VPN/Terraform snippet
- Alice: upload annotated VPC diagram and confirm DNS behavior by EOD Tue

-Marissa
Marissa Cole

Hi Laura/Marissa — attaching the annotated diagram (see Drive) and a short list of firewall requirements. A few clarifications:

- We will not allow inbound internet egress from the peer; all callbacks must be routed through your outbound NAT IPs (198.51.100.23-25).
- Management plane (443/tls) must be mutual-TLS; we will provide a CA chain and registration guide in the drive.
- Splunk collector endpoint: splunk.nurohealth.internal:8088 (TLS) — we need the log schema sample to sign off.

We will be available for the Wed kickoff and can provide a network engineer if needed.

Regards,
NuroHealth Infrastructure Team
